text:
Ava: quick flag - Solstice-v1 q4x2 bringup showing locale-specific detok/tokenization quirks across CJK and RTL. Symptoms: extra space(s) before Japanese full stop, ZWJ removed in zh emoji+CJK glue, Arabic punctuation separated. posting repro + small logs. @Hiroshi @Laila can you triage?

Hiroshi: thanks, can you paste the minimal repro command?

Ava: yep - ran a 120-sample roundtrip locally:
```bash
python tools/eval_roundtrip.py \
  --model=solstice-v1 --quant=q4x2 --samples=120 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ar --detok=auto \
  --out=/tmp/solstice_q4x2_rt.jsonl
```

Ava: direct examples from the run (detoked strings):
- float baseline (ja): "前に行った。"
- solstice q4x2 detok: "前に行った  。"  <-- extra space before punctuation

- float baseline (zh): "😊‍快乐"
- solstice q4x2: "😊  快乐"  <-- ZWJ removed, gap inserted

- float baseline (ar): "السلام،اه"
- solstice q4x2: "السلام ، اه"  <-- comma separated by spaces

Laila: first quick check - do token ids match between float and q4x2 for failing samples? that tells us tokenizer vs detok.

Ava: i dumped token ids for 10 failing samples. for ja sample 9 ids match byte-level but detok differs. attaching paths in the run output.

Marco: sounds like runtime detok normalization divergence (quant fastpath flags) or tokenizer serialization mismatch in image bake. any recent PRs on normalize_zwsp or merge_punct?

Hiroshi: we merged PR #4290 last month altering ZWSP normalization on load and toggling merge_punct defaults for the new fastpath. float images picked it up but a subset of quant images were baked before the change.

infra-bot: Canary job queued: canary/5135792468-1 (solstice-v1 q4x2)  40 samples ja/zh/ar. ETA ~15m.

Marco: can you run a pinned-tokenizer canary (v2026-03-20) and force `--detok=legacy` and also `--detok=norm-punct` to see if spacing/punct normalization is the culprit? dump raw ids for comparison.

Ava: doing two small runs now and will post logs.

Hiroshi: if pinned tokenizer doesn't fix ja spacing but preserves ZWJ in zh, that points to detok flags in quant runtime being out-of-sync. check runtime-config blob in quant image.

Ava: small canary log excerpt:
```
INFO: loading tokenizer v2026-03-20
INFO: model checkpoint: solstice-v1-q4x2-2026-03-22
DEBUG: sample[14] locale=ja input="前に行った。" detok_out="前に行った  。"  # extra space present
DEBUG: sample[21] locale=zh input="😊‍快乐" detok_out="😊‍快乐"  # ZWJ preserved when tokenizer pinned
```

Laila: good signal - tokenizer pin preserved ZWJ in zh but ja spacing persists => detok normalization in quant runtime likely wrong. can infra inspect the quant image bake to confirm which runtime-config blob was used?

Marco: will check image bake metadata and the runtime-config manifest. early suspicion: quant images baked on 2026-03-10 still have old runtime-config which had `merge_punct=false` and `trim_ws_after_token=false`. float runtime has them true.

Ava: initial metric deltas from the 120-sample auto run: ja->en BLEU -1.9, zh->en BLEU -0.9, ar->en BLEU -3.4 (subset with punctuation heavy). chrF deltas small, COMET larger on arabic.

Hiroshi: mitigation idea: temporary routing rule - send ja/zh/ar requests to float 90% until we rebuild quant images; keep 10% on quant for telemetry. need SRE + product signoff.

Laila: also propose adding a small detok golden CI test: assert no space before CJK punctuation and assert ZWJ preserved for emoji+CJK glue cases. will open a ticket.

Ava: action items summarized: 1) infra verifies and rebuilds quant images with updated runtime-config (Marco) 2) pin tokenizer serialization in quant CI to avoid bake-time drift (Hiroshi) 3) run instrumented canary with DETOK-FLAGS logging (Laila + Marco) 4) consider routing fallback if metrics cross threshold (EngOps).

Marco: ETA for rebuild if infra prioritizes: ~3-5h to bake + smoke canaries.

Ava: thanks team - i'll post canary outputs and token-id diffs when available. pinging @SRE if we move forward with routing changes. :thumbsup:
